# Literal complex-frame retiming and complete admission

PR315's complete package is preserved unchanged under `vendor/pr315`, including
its source manifest, complex gcert, checker implementations and theorem-source
pins. The raw gcert SHA256 is
`91c349b9680b023449d3bc4fb58f00a22c9d9f38b776ae3a3597259431de78eb`.

Each grouped fan-out/fan-in expands to the same ordered scalar additions. An
empty fan-out retains any spectator incidences. Thus the exact rational scalar
word is unchanged, including its scatter cut. At any gate, permitted common
frames lie between the span of its predecessor frames and the intersection of
its successor frames. Both endpoints are computed as exact reduced binary
bases, and the emitted full label walk independently checks containment.

For a candidate common rank k with predecessor/successor ranks a and b, the
rank-product contribution is the product of `(k-a)^(k-a)*(b-k)^(b-k)`, with the
zero contribution interpreted as one. Its logarithm is convex in k, so a local
maximizer occurs at one of the two exact endpoint frames. Selection compares
integer products; floating-point values are diagnostic only. A strict product
increase guides discovery, and both exact moment engines decide final price.
There is no global-optimality claim.

The second stage treats each maximal same-frame component joined by consecutive
role incidences as one variable. Each role has one entering and one leaving
boundary for that component. The same exact endpoint/product argument applies.
The last pre-scatter gate for each retained source is locked, so the original
22 rank-20 copied-centre frames remain exact. The first two stages use only strict improvements. The added stages below allow histogram-preserving neutral moves.

The first stage has 29 changes and the second has 69 component changes (186 gate
edits). Every non-frame field of the literal scalar word is independently
compared to the source. Complete forward and reflected-backward emitted words
including old response, copied centres and cleanup have exactly the original
scalar schedule hashes and bills. Arbitrary dirty restoration uses the same
inherited dirty-lifting theorem under newly checked nested labels; this is not
a claim of a new all-column Lean proof.

The local histogram has 68,219 calls and rank mass 254,672. Five copies plus the
four idle families at ranks 4, 21, 42 and 46 produce 351,655 calls and rank mass
1,571,680. All copied-centre and final-climb calls remain explicit. The family
parameters m=110, live stock 14,316 and physical stock 23,375 are unchanged, and
`110*14316-1571680 = 3080`. The finite accounting recomputes its adapter charge
from this actual count and retains the source's compiler, routing and row
overcharges. Coefficients stay on denominators 1, 2, 3 and 6; complete actual
scalar bills and temporary lifetimes are checked in both directions.

With fallback density `10^-16` and `32*m*m` rank-one calls for every paid child,
both independent rational interval engines admit
`772881996923825/10^18` and reject its adjacent grid point. The no-fallback root
`772882000348983/10^18` is recorded separately and is not substituted for the
conservative supplier root.

`portable-code/DERIVATION.json` lists every parameterization made to the retained
label/splice/finite helpers. Changes replace old baseline frame/gate/histogram
count pins with the hash-bound candidate counts and independently recomputed
phase ledgers. All nesting, scalar, ownership, lifecycle, denominator, invoice,
rank/stock, finite-guard and mutation checks remain active. Root verification
checks manifest integrity both before and after the fresh replay.

A future combined result must rerun the bit word's own full admission, bind this
fresh supplier receipt, and recompute all outer assembly constraints with the
new complex coarse rate. Existing PR319 files and claims are unchanged here.

## Histogram-preserving neutral continuation

After the unchanged first two stages, the component algorithm runs toward lower
endpoint frames and then toward upper endpoint frames. A neutral change is
allowed only when its exact rank-product objective and the complete multiset of
positive boundary ranks are unchanged. Thus each such move preserves the entire
paid local moment, including its call count and full fallback coefficient.
Newly exposed strict changes are only discovery proposals: both final rational
moment engines and the full supplier admission decide the final bound.

The downward stage makes 50 component edits, including 23 strict changes; the
upward stage makes 672 component edits, including one strict change.
The exact final program SHA256 is `ea52d07910dca90871c2cd928894f491e305fa10edabd2f220cb45f0648e61a5`. Scalar order, coefficients,
ports, start/final labels and all scatter sources remain byte-for-byte equal
after scalar expansion. Both complete dirty-response/cleanup scalar words,
all nested/reflected frame ledgers, Sussman scalar and mirror checks,
mutation controls, copied-centre lifetimes, complete finite costs and precision
guards are rerun fresh. Every selection and stage output is pinned.

The result is a stronger complex supplier only. Its use with a new bit word
still requires that word's independent full admission and a fresh exact outer
assembly against the bound fresh complex receipt. No separate supplier gains
are added, and no kappa claim is made by this supplier package.
